<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Currently, when consensus checker enabled, in a deployement of PP prefill and TP decode, the prefill process fails **during warmup**.

The failure messages are: (keyword `max_new_tokens`)
```
[2026-10-26 06:47:04 PP0] Found rank divergence for 4 events(s)! local hash: 8c66d3efda24c238276585a94f94721e8ac1ce3e, events = ["match_prefix called params=params=MatchPrefixParams(... req=Req(... max_new_tokens=8 ...
[2026-10-26 06:47:04 PP1] Found rank divergence for 4 events(s)! local hash: 927c295b9e06d16c3aabbb6a8927fe60e3705aef, events = ["match_prefix called params=params=MatchPrefixParams(... req=Req(... max_new_tokens=1 ...
[2026-10-26 06:47:04 PP2] Found rank divergence for 4 events(s)! local hash: 927c295b9e06d16c3aabbb6a8927fe60e3705aef, events = ["match_prefix called params=params=MatchPrefixParams(... req=Req(... max_new_tokens=1 ...
[2026-10-26 06:47:04 PP3] Found rank divergence for 4 events(s)! local hash: 927c295b9e06d16c3aabbb6a8927fe60e3705aef, events = ["match_prefix called params=params=MatchPrefixParams(... req=Req(... max_new_tokens=1 ...
```

When calling `UnifiedRadixCache.match_prefix`, PP0 passes `Req` with `max_new_tokens=8`, and other PP ranks passes `max_new_tokens=1`.

Timeline:
1. **PP0** receives a warmup request with `max_new_tokens=8`.
2. **PP1** calls `UnifiedRadixCache.match_prefix`, passing `max_new_tokens=8`.
3. **PP0** sets `max_new_tokens=1` in `Scheduler._add_request_to_queue -> ._prefetch_kvcache -> PrefillBootstrapQueue.add -> .create_sender -> ._process_req`.
4. **PP0** sends the request to **PP1**, with `max_new_tokens=1`.
5. **PP1** receives the warmup request, with `max_new_tokens=1`.
6. **PP1** calls `UnifiedRadixCache.match_prefix`, passing `max_new_tokens=1`.  **Divergence detected!**

For now, it is not harmful to `match_prefix` with `max_new_tokens` difference, as it does nothing on that parameter.  However, it would be nice to fix the root cause to prevent it from harming the future code.


## Modifications

1. Move `max_new_tokens=1` to `Scheduler.init_req_max_new_tokens`, which is called for every request at very early stage.
2. Enable consensus checker for PD tests.

## Tests

The server fails to start up before this fix.  It succeeded after the fix.

<details>

Startup command:

```sh
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com

# router
nohup env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
  python -m sglang_router.launch_router \
  --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --pd-disaggregation \
  --prefill http://127.0.0.1:30000 \
  --decode http://127.0.0.1:30001 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 9000 > router.log 2>&1 &

# prefill
nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 \
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
SGLANG_ENABLE_RANK_CONSENSUS_CHECKER=1 \
sglang serve \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --pp-size=4 \
  --tp-size=1 \
  --moe-runner-backend marlin \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 30000 \
  --chunked-prefill-size=8192 \
  --enable-metrics \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 \
  --hicache-ratio=2 \
  --disaggregation-mode=prefill \
  --enable-metrics \
  --enable-hierarchical-cache \
  --hicache-storage-backend=mooncake \
  --hicache-storage-backend-extra-config '{"master_server_address": "127.0.0.1:50051", "local_hostname": "localhost", "metadata_server": "http://127.0.0.1:8080/metadata", "global_segment_size": "256gb", "protocol": "tcp"}' \
  --log-level=debug > prefill.log 2>&1 &



# decode
nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7 \
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
sglang serve \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --tp-size=4 \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 \
  --moe-runner-backend marlin \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 30001 \
  --enable-metrics \
  --disaggregation-mode=decode > decode.log 2>&1 &
```

</details>

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).

+    def test_pd_prefill_forces_one_handoff_token(self):
+        """Bug regression: a PD-prefill request whose memory budget clamps to
+        0 became is_prefill_only, so the prefill node shipped a dummy token 0
+        that the decode node committed as the user's first output token.
+        Prefill must bypass the clamps and always budget exactly one token."""
+
+        # Pool of 32 with a 30-token prompt: the memory clamp below the
+        # PREFILL branch would compute max(0, 32 - 30 - 1 - 1) = 0.
+        scheduler = self._new_scheduler(max_total_num_tokens=32)
+        scheduler.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+
+        req = self._new_req(max_new_tokens=64, input_len=30, min_new_tokens=8)
+        scheduler.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
+        self.assertEqual(req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(req.sampling_params.min_new_tokens, 1)
+
+        # Without a user minimum, EOS stays legal as the handoff token.
+        req = self._new_req(max_new_tokens=None, input_len=30, min_new_tokens=0)
+        scheduler.init_req_max_new_tokens(req)
+        self.assertEqual(req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(req.sampling_params.min_new_tokens, 0)
